_comment: Wall plates from the Feynman Lectures figures. Each entry = one A4 page: the figure recoloured in its tier's palette, with a caption underneath written in the Lectures' own register (terse, declarative, physical — never AI filler). EDIT THIS FILE FREELY: move an image between tiers, reword any caption, or set skip:true. Nothing here is in code. Run: python chalkify.py --plates feynman-plates.json

key.meaning: Most important — the deepest physics. White chalk on black slate.
key.contains: quantum, relativity, fields, nuclear, wave optics

medium.meaning: Middle — fields, biology, the spectrum. Gold on navy (house colours).

lesser.meaning: Foundational — introductory mechanics and chemistry. Navy on gold (house colours).

_captionStyle: Feynman's register: terse and technical. Say what the figure SHOWS and state the physics plainly. No editorialising, no flourishes, no 'this amazing diagram'. One title line, then one to three sentences.

plates.title: Interference experiment with electrons
plates.caption: (a) The apparatus: electrons from the gun pass a wall with two holes and arrive at the backstop. (b) The distributions P₁ and P₂ observed with one hole open at a time. (c) The distribution P₁₂ observed with both open. P₁₂ = |φ₁ + φ₂|², not P₁ + P₂: the amplitudes add, and only then is the square taken.
plates._filenameWarning: The filename says 'Diffraction Pattern Graph', but the figure is the two-hole electron experiment. The caption follows the figure, not the filename.

plates.title: The same experiment, watched
plates.caption: A light source at A shows which hole each electron passes through. With the electrons observed, the interference disappears and the distributions simply add: P′₁₂ = P′₁ + P′₂.

plates.title: An array of in-phase oscillators
plates.caption: An array of length L radiating with no phase delay (α = 0), and the intensity pattern it produces. The first zero lies at the angle θ₁ at which the path difference across the array is one wavelength λ.

plates.title: The light clock
plates.caption: A light clock moving at speed u, drawn in the frame S. The pulse travels the two slant paths, each ½cτ, while the clock itself advances ½uτ; D is the mirror separation. Since c is the same for both observers, the moving clock runs slow.
plates._note: Light-clock / time-dilation construction: the two slanted legs are each ½cτ, the horizontal offset ½uτ, and D is the mirror separation.

plates.file: X Ct X dash Ct Dash.webp
plates.title: How not to draw it
plates.caption: (a) An incorrect diagram of a decay in spacetime, drawn on the axes x–ct and x′–ct′ of two observers.

plates.title: Radioactive decay
plates.caption: The radioactivity of a sample against time. The fraction remaining halves in every period T: one half after T, one quarter after 2T, one eighth after 3T.

plates.title: The force between two atoms
plates.caption: The force F between two atoms as a function of their separation r. Beyond the separation d the atoms attract, with F = k/r⁷; closer than d they repel.

plates.title: Deflecting an electron beam
plates.caption: Electrons from a hot filament are accelerated through the potential V, deflected by a pair of charged plates and by a magnet, and strike a fluorescent screen.

plates.title: Amplitudes with a quadratic phase delay
plates.caption: The addition of amplitudes for many in-phase oscillators whose phase delays vary as the square of the distance from the point D of the previous figure.
plates._note: Identified by Patryk 2026-07-14 from the Lectures: this is the Cornu-spiral amplitude addition, NOT magnetic field lines as first guessed. Caption is the Lectures' own wording.

plates.title: The addition of amplitudes
plates.caption: The addition of amplitudes for many oscillators of equal strength, the phase of each advancing uniformly around the curve. The points C, D and E mark the resultant at successive stages.
plates._note: The companion 'previous figure' to the Cornu spiral — the vibration curve whose point D the other caption refers to. Check the wording if you have the original.

plates.title: The structure of DNA
plates.caption: Two chains of ribose sugar and phosphate, bridged by the base pairs A:B and C:D. Each base pairs only with its own partner, so either chain determines the other.

plates.title: The electromagnetic spectrum
plates.caption: From an electrical disturbance at 10² oscillations per second to the γ-rays of cosmic radiation at 10²⁷. The rough behaviour is called a field, a wave, or a particle according to the frequency.

plates.title: The refraction of sunlight
plates.caption: Light from the sun bends as it passes down through the atmosphere, which is denser near the ground. The sun is seen along the line the light finally arrives on, higher than it truly is.

plates.title: A cubic array of atoms
plates.caption: Sodium and chlorine atoms alternating on a cubic lattice. Nearest neighbour distance d = a/2.

plates.title: Equal carts on a track
plates.caption: Two equal carts in successive experiments (a) to (e). In each, whether they bounce, spin, or stick, the total momentum after the collision equals the total momentum before.

plates.title: A loaded beam
plates.caption: The weight W balances loads of 60 and 100 placed along the beam. For equilibrium the moments about the pivot must cancel: each load counts for its size times its distance.

plates.title: Weight on an inclined plane
plates.caption: Stevinus's figure. On a frictionless triangle of sides 3, 4 and 5, the weight W is held by a pull of 1 lb along the slope.

plates.title: The addition of vectors in space
plates.caption: Each vector is fixed by its three components, and the sum is obtained by adding the components one at a time. The result does not depend on how the axes are turned.

plates.file: Change in Velocity not sure what it exactly displays.webp
plates.title: The change in velocity
plates.caption: The velocities v₁ and v₂ at two instants on a curved path of radius R, separated by the angle Δθ. The difference of the two arrows drawn where they stand is not Δv: the vectors must first be brought to a common origin.
plates._note: Patryk's filename said he was unsure what this shows. It is the standard warning figure for finding delta-v on a curved path: the 'delta-v? No!' construction.

_tierBalance: Tiers are importance-ranked, then split into roughly even thirds so all three palettes appear on the wall about equally (7 / 6 / 6). Move any file between tiers here — nothing in the code cares.
